appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn in Caemlyn
appearances.notable_actions: Runs back to the inn after encountering Elaida; reports to Master Gill; reunites joyfully with Moiraine, Lan, Nynaeve, Egwene, and Perrin; takes them upstairs to see Mat; struggles internally with questions about his parentage
appearances.demeanor: relieved and joyful at reunion, but anxious about threats from Elaida and Whitecloaks; defensive when accused of lying; worried about Mat

appearances.notable_actions: Plays stones with Loial; listens to Rand's account of meeting Elaida; warns that Rand must leave the city within two days; offers to lend horses and pay for Mother Grubb; confronts Whitecloak under-officer; threatens to call Queen's Guards; stands up to Whitecloaks and drives them out; agrees to let Moiraine stay and help with the rat problem
appearances.demeanor: initially skeptical, then alarmed; surprisingly brave and angry when confronting Whitecloaks; later stunned by his own courage

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn, library

appearances.whereabouts: Upstairs room at The Queen's Blessing, in bed

appearances.demeanor: feverish, paranoid, hostile, hateful, violent, corrupted by Mashadar

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn, kitchen and upstairs room
appearances.notable_actions: Arrives with the group from Emond's Field; finds Rand through the city using some kind of tracking; scratches a cat; offers to help Master Gill with rat problem; goes upstairs to Mat's room; instantly senses the evil of Mashadar in Mat; seizes Nynaeve and pulls her away from the bed; explains the danger of the Shadar Logoth dagger; prepares to use her angreal to heal Mat; orders everyone out of the room
appearances.demeanor: serene, focused, alarmed when she senses Mat's corruption, authoritative, urgent

appearances.whereabouts: The Queen's Blessing inn, kitchen and upstairs room
